description_en: Queries the details of 5G message assets in batches
description_zh: 批量查询5G消息素材详情
name: QueryRCSAssetList

parameters.help_en: The signature name. This parameter is required and can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 签名名称。非空，最长128字符
parameters.name: sign_name

parameters.help_en: The asset code. This parameter is required and can be up to 64 characters in length. This code is returned when you create an asset by calling the [CreateRCSAsset](~~CreateRCSAsset~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 素材编码。非空，最长64字符。通过[CreateRCSAsset](~~CreateRCSAsset~~)接口创建素材时返回
parameters.name: asset_code

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. The value must be greater than 0
parameters.help_zh: 当前页码，从1开始，必须大于0
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The expiration status filter. If this parameter is not specified, all assets are returned. Valid values:

0: not expired.
1: expired
parameters.help_zh:
过期状态筛选，不传则返回全部。取值：

0：未过期。
1：已过期
parameters.name: expire_status
